This part of the manual describes what the desk expects

Companion Animal Travel Desk Safety and Handling Rules

The purpose of this section is to prevent avoidable distress, exposure, and delay when animals are accepted for travel through Aurelia Skyways. The desk shall treat every booking as a safety matter, not a comfort preference, and shall act at once when a case appears uncertain. Staff must listen closely when a passenger is worried, because concern often signals a condition that needs immediate review. <<FACT F012>> Any animal that shows signs of injury, panic, escape risk, or poor fit for the crate must be referred to the senior coordinator before acceptance proceeds.

The desk shall confirm that the transport container is secure, clean, and suitable for the species before any handoff is approved. Food, water, and medication instructions must be recorded in clear plain language, and any warning from the owner must be passed without delay to the loading team. <<FACT F028>> Animals placed in quarantine or separated holding must never be combined with other animals unless the veterinary lead gives direct clearance. Staff must refuse any request that would force a hurried handover, conceal a concern, or bypass normal checks. The service treats each journey as a shared responsibility, and no one may shift that duty onto another desk or assume that a prior review removes the need for fresh inspection.

If a traveler such as Mariam Chaudhary, Layla Petrov, or any other passenger raises a concern, the desk shall slow the process and verify the record again before release. Any uncertainty about fit, containment, labeling, or routing must be escalated immediately, and the animal must remain under supervision until the issue is resolved. Contact the senior coordinator and the duty manager at once for any breach, doubt, or welfare alarm.
